spec.reason: The Section 6.8(c) capital expenditure limit does not have a fixed threshold. Under clause (ii), unused capex from one fiscal year (up to 50% of that year's permitted amount) carries forward and raises the next year's limit. Under clause (iii), certain acquisition spending is disregarded in a year when the Convertibles Trigger Event occurs.
